keyPhrases.text: Dust off your character shoes. Our time is now.
Tveit and DeBose are particularly electric
impossible not to root for them
the punch lines are clever and often acidic
all the other songs on the show, are pretty darn good
embodies why whimsy can be so appealing
more one longs for goofy elation

reasoning: Enthusiastic recommendation for musical theater fans with genuine praise for performances, songs, and comedy. Some minor criticisms about limited scope of humor, but overall tone is appreciative and recommending, particularly the rallying cry 'Our time is now' to musical lovers.
